events.title: The Science and Social Impact of Meditation with Dr. Richard Davidson
events.description:
Meditation is more than a path to personal well-being—it also nurtures resilience, reduces social bias, and fosters more compassionate societies. 

Join Dr. Richard Davidson, founder of the Center for Healthy Minds and close collaborator of the Dalai Lama, for a talk exploring the science behind meditation’s transformative impact. A pioneer in contemplative neuroscience, Dr. Davidson will share groundbreaking insights about the pro-social effects of meditation, in person and online, open to all!
